text: Start: checklist says 'STEP: Survey' with items Grime/Debris/... but nothing on screen says what surveying means (look at each problem? walk inside?). 'Grime' is already ticked at tick ~134 just because the crosshair spawns on a grimy wall, which reads like it was pre-completed. Clock 'am' sits tight against right edge.

Survey of 'Rotten floorboards' needed a precise aim: crosshair right beside the dark/green patch still read plain 'Floorboards' (shots rot3/rot4); only when dead on it did it say 'Rotten floorboard' and tick. The patch also looks like a shadowed checker rather than rotten wood.

At tick ~2800, walkto debris then E while looking level did nothing and gave no feedback (debris 0.9m away directly ahead, below view). Had to tilt ~60 deg down for E to work. A 'nothing in reach / look down' cue would help. Once carrying, the 'Carrying: E to put down (outside to haul out)' line is clear.

Two 'Fallen shingle' debris (1.0m, bearing +11/+15) sit under/inside the snow drift. Pressing E aimed there does nothing and gives no message; the crosshair only names 'Snow drift'. A player can't tell the shingles are blocked by the snow (or that they exist). Several hauling trips silently failed here (ticks 6000-10500).

Clearing 15 debris (17 after the rafter is sawn) one piece per trip to the door took from tick ~3300 to ~21900 (~10 game minutes, i.e. most of a first 15-minute session) with no way to carry more than one. Feels like a chore; consider carrying 2-3 small pieces or a quicker toss. Also walking up to a piece and pressing E can silently fail when it is >12 deg off the crosshair.

Sweeping: the per-spot meter ('71% clean', 'Clean here. Move on.') and the checklist % are clear, but in this dim interior the dusty and swept boards look almost the same, so it's hard to see which parts of the floor are still dirty. After ~4 game minutes of sweeping the floor is only 42%. F5 'Saved.' feedback is good.
